image_description: A low-angle shot of two intersecting street signs mounted on a dark metal pole against a blurred urban background with buildings and bare trees. The top sign is green with white text, and the bottom sign is red with white text. Both signs feature distorted, illegible text that resembles gibberish or alien script rather than standard English typography. The signs appear slightly warped and fused at the mounting point.
